first.rationale: The concurrent onboarding-completion and activation declines make onboarding simplification the most direct reversible lever for restoring sustainable qualified revenue. Verify the two closely related but distinct onboarding records before committing, since their relevance is highly consequential. Guard against reduced qualification quality while measuring activation and downstream qualified revenue.

final.rationale: Run a controlled simplification of the onboarding flow this week. The verified shortened-flow result directly addresses both current declines, improving completion by 13%, reducing time-to-value by 2.1 days, and increasing 30-day retention by 3%. Include SMB analysis, but avoid treating signup simplification as universally applicable because its evidence is SMB-only and showed a 1% retention decline despite qualified-revenue growth. Evaluate qualified revenue and retention alongside completion and activation before any rollout.
